Your home is not a hotel. 🛎️ Welcome to Hotel Max.

Max is seven. Ding! The cereal bowl stays on the table. The toys stay on the floor. Room service picks it all up. He's not lazy. He's just learning dependence.

Fast-forward twelve years. Max is nineteen, the dishes are piled to the ceiling… and nobody's coming. 🍽️

So one Saturday, Mom closes the hotel. 3 house rules:
1️⃣ You made it? Clean it.
2️⃣ You used it? Put it back.
3️⃣ Help. "If you live in a home, you help the home." 🏠

It takes weeks. Week one: grumbling. 😤 Week two: meh. By the fourth, he does it anyway. It isn't punishment. It's preparation. ❤️

Research found that kindergartners who did more chores felt more capable by third grade: at school, with friends and in life. 💪

Jesus, the King of heaven, knelt down and washed His friends' feet. "I have given you an example, that you also should do just as I have done to you." John 13:15 (ESV) 🙏

Fast-forward again: Christmas, Max is nineteen, and he's the one picking up the plates. That's not a hotel. That's home. 🎄❤️

And if your child won't even try, it might be worry, not laziness.
